verifications.claim: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026, in observance of Good Friday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq — will be closed on Friday, April 3, in observance of the Christian holiday.' R2: 'United States stock markets will be closed on Friday, April 3, in observance of Good Friday... The Nasdaq and New York Stock Exchange will be closed on Friday.' R4: 'Good Friday: Friday, April 3'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state NYSE and Nasdaq closure on April 3, 2026, for Good Friday.
